name: Mento South African Rand
oneLiner: ZARm is Mento's South African rand stablecoin on Celo, minted CDP-style against USDm collateral (Mento V3, a Liquity v2 fork).
collateral: Mento V3 Liquity-v2-style CDPs collateralized by USDm; USDm in turn is backed by the diversified Mento Reserve mix (sUSDS, CELO, EURC, USDC, USDT, axlEUROC, stETH, and smaller positions exposed via the Mento reserve dashboard).
pegMechanism: Mento V3 oracle-priced FX stablecoin minted by depositing USDm as CDP collateral and borrowing ZARm against it; user-set interest rates, Stability Pool liquidations, and Liquity-style redemptions support the ZARm peg, with circuit breakers and Mento reserve transparency on the upstream USDm leg.

oracleRisk.summary: Mento's current Celo oracle-priced stable paths use external rate sources through OracleAdapter/SortedOracles and BreakerBox validity gates. The current reserve inventory has no active ZARm borrower-CDP branch.

branchApplicability.rationale: Mento's current reserve API reports active CDP troves only for GBPm, JPYm, and CHFm, all against USDm; it reports no active ZARm troves. Mento's current Celo/CDP docs identify GBPm as the live collateralized stable path, while oracle-priced FPMM assets use the swap-rate path. There is therefore no current ZARm borrower-specific liquidation branch to inventory under V9.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: The current holder-facing ZARm token has no direct blacklist, freeze, pause, seizure, arbitrary-account burn, or transfer-hook restriction. Timelocked proxy upgrade authority is recorded in mint-authority evidence but is not itself a currently executable holder-freeze surface. This direct conclusion does not suppress reserve-derived upstream exposure.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Celo block 72189914, ZARm proxy 0x4c35853a3b4e647fd266f4de678dcc8fec410bf6 resolved to StableTokenV2 implementation 0x434563B0604BE100F04B7Ae485BcafE3c9D8850E and a 172800-second Mento Timelock owner. The verified active implementation has ordinary ERC-20 transfer and transferFrom, permissioned minting, and burn(uint256) only for msg.sender; it has no direct blacklist, freeze, pause, seizure, arbitrary-holder burn, or transfer hook. The direct token-level freeze posture is therefore No as of this review. USDT, EURC, and USDC-family reserve collateral remains separately represented and can still produce computed upstream exposure.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: ZARm has one tracked Celo deployment and reviewed Mento docs describe obtaining Mento stables on Celo. No durable cross-chain route was verified for this asset, so it is triaged as single-chain/native. 2026-07-20 cohort dc-1 pass: added the reviewed native home-chain route row.

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-3 (lead usdd-tron-dao-reserve)
reserveReview.rationale: ZARm mints through the oracle-priced FPMM/BiPoolManager path against the shared Mento Reserve: the reserve analytics API reports active borrower CDP troves only for GBPm, JPYm, CHFm, and XOFm, and none for ZARm (see the oracle-risk branch review). ZARm's reserve exposure is therefore the shared Mento Reserve basket, fetched 2026-07-20: AUSD 27.1%, sUSDS 24.4%, CELO 17.8%, USDT 12.3%, EURC 12.0%, USDC 3.9%, stETH 2.5% (a 0.0007% WETH residual rounds out). This replaces the earlier single-slice 'USDm CDP collateral' representation, which described a CDP branch that has no active ZARm troves.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Mento reserve analytics API collateral.assets composition fetched on 2026-07-20
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No unresolved basket exposure: every slice is either a tracked stablecoin link or a resolved exogenous crypto asset. The upstream composition of linked stablecoins (AUSD, sUSDS, USDT, EURC, USDC) is scored on those assets' own records.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: CELO is the Celo network's volatile native asset, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.
stETH is a Lido ETH staking receipt, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.

providers.name: Mento Reserve smart contract (Celo), controlled by Mento governance behind the 172800-second timelock

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-3 (lead usdd-tron-dao-reserve)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: The shared Mento Reserve is self-custodied in on-chain protocol contracts on Celo under Mento governance (48-hour timelock per the 2026-07-15 access review); there is no third-party custodian, trust, or SPV, so no legal segregation or bankruptcy-remoteness structure exists. Parts of the basket are deployed into yield-bearing positions (sUSDS savings shares, stETH staking), which is protocol-level redeployment of reserve assets rather than custodian rehypothecation; per-asset account segregation inside the reserve contract is not published.
